Are TCB thread lift reviews bad? Explaining the actual situation of failure risk and effectiveness

"What does TCB's thread lift actually do?"

"I'm worried about the reviews of people who have failed, so I have a hard time making reservations."

As mentioned above, many people may continue to collect information while holding off on deciding whether or not to undergo treatment.

At TCB Tokyo Central Cosmetic Surgery, we offer multiple thread lift treatments that aim to lift sagging skin using medical threads without making an incision.

Thread lifts come with risks such as swelling, internal bleeding, pulling, and side-to-side disparity, and may not always give you the desired result.

Thread lift for cosmetic purposes is a free medical treatment and is not covered by public medical insurance.

In this article, we will explain things to be careful about when checking reviews and things to check regarding treatment details, risks, downtime, fees, and counseling based on TCB official information.

In addition, we will discuss points to check when determining suitability and lifestyle habits related to maintenance after treatment.

When considering TCB Thread Lift, don't rely solely on anonymous reviews to determine its effectiveness, but also compare official information and doctors' explanations.

What you can learn from this article
  • Points to keep in mind when checking reviews and reputation of TCB thread lift (how to judge posted content)
  • Cases of failure and risks that should be known in advance (left-right difference, downtime, lack of effectiveness)
  • The reality of downtime and things to be careful about after treatment
Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

Points to consider when checking reviews and reputation of TCB thread lift

When looking up reviews about TCB's thread lift, you need to check the source of the posted content and the treatment conditions.

Organizing satisfaction, dissatisfaction, and Chiebukuro reputation from three perspectives
  • Points to check when reading good reviews
  • Points to check when reading bad reviews
  • Points to note when checking the reputation of TCB thread lift on Chiebukuro

It may not be possible to confirm the type and number of threads used, the date of treatment, the doctor in charge, and the length of time that has elapsed just from word of mouth.

When reading the evaluation of the finished product, be sure to distinguish between when the photo was taken and whether the evaluation was taken after the swelling had subsided.

Check both opinions without bias, and then consider the treatment in light of your own situation and wishes.

Points to check when reading good reviews

When reading good reviews, check to see if the name of the treatment, number of treatments, and duration of treatment are specifically written.

TCB official explains that the thread lift aims to improve the sagging and sagging face line, but the effects vary from person to person.

The downtime recommended by the TCB official is approximately 1 week for swelling and pain, and 1 to 2 weeks for internal bleeding.

Things to check when considering good reviews
  • Confirmed the treatment name, number of threads, and timing.
  • Discount application conditions and total payment amount are clearly stated.
  • Post-operative care is specifically described.

During your consultation, ask your doctor about the type, number, and position of the threads to be inserted, as well as the limits of the changes you can expect.

When considering monitoring fees, etc., it is important to check the total amount including the posting conditions, regular fees, and additional costs.

Regarding aftercare, please check in advance the post-surgery consultation method, contact information, and costs if additional procedures are required.

In order to judge the level of satisfaction, it is helpful not only to look at the evaluations, but also to see if the patient's expectations before the procedure and the progress after the procedure are explained in detail.

Please clarify all your questions during your consultation before proceeding with the treatment.

Points to check when reading bad reviews

When reading posts about dissatisfaction, be sure to separate them into areas of dissatisfaction: swelling, tightness, left-right disparity, cost, and explanation.

Swelling and internal bleeding vary from person to person, and may last longer than the general guideline provided by the TCB official.

Downtime for thread lifts varies from person to person, and swelling may be prolonged. Please adjust your schedule before your treatment and consult a medical institution as soon as possible if you have any worrying symptoms.

Three things to check to avoid dissatisfaction and regrets
  • Check for the possibility that swelling and internal bleeding may last longer than expected.
  • Check risks such as left-right difference, tightening, duration, etc.
  • Check the explanation of fees and aftercare

Left-right differences and tension are also included in the complications and postoperative symptoms of thread lift explained by TCB official.

Don't judge the post-surgery consultation methods and scope of support based solely on testimonials online; check in writing before signing a contract.

Keeping in mind that there may be a difference between the outcome expected at the time of counseling and the actual progress, recording the explanations will make it easier to compare.

It is important to read what the poster was dissatisfied with by dividing it into the preliminary explanation, postoperative course, and fees.

Be sure to check the following three points on the day of your consultation: price, downtime, and corrections.

Points to note when checking the reputation of TCB thread lift on Chiebukuro

When searching for information about TCB thread lifts on anonymous posting services such as Yahoo! Chiebukuro, please be aware that it is not possible to confirm whether the respondents have actually experienced the procedure.

In particular, please check the posting timing and treatment menu before reading about "downtime," "duration of effect," and "total fee."

Three points to check in Chiebukuro etc.
  • How much downtime is there?
  • How long does the effect last?
  • Are the prices reasonable compared to other hospitals?

It is not possible to judge the effectiveness of TCB treatment or the doctor's skill based solely on anonymous responses, so cross-checking with official information is essential.

Answers on Chiebukuro may be based on the subjective opinion of the poster, and conditions such as the time of treatment, thread used, and doctor in charge may also vary.

It may not be possible to confirm the authenticity of the treatment conditions or posted content with anonymous reviews. Please keep this information for reference only and check with your doctor's explanation and primary information.

This article does not include a comprehensive tally of the number of posts, so it is not possible to determine whether there are more positive or negative reviews.

When you find a review that interests you, ask questions during your consultation to see if the symptoms and costs listed apply to your treatment plans.

Possible troubles with TCB thread lift and risks you should know in advance

In addition to swelling, pain, and internal bleeding, a thread lift carries risks such as side-to-side difference, exposure of the threads, infection, and numbness.

Based on TCB's official explanation, we will divide the main points that you should understand before the treatment into three parts.

Three risks to check with TCB thread lift
  • Possibility of left-right differences or pulling in the finish
  • Downtime may be longer than expected
  • Possibility of not experiencing the desired effect

Differences in left-right results, tightening, prolonged downtime, and lack of actual effect are points that you should receive explanations about before the treatment.

Although not everyone is at risk, it is important to know who to contact and how to seek medical attention if you feel something is wrong.

It is not possible to completely prevent postoperative symptoms with advance explanation alone. If you have any concerns, ask your doctor and check the guidelines for your visit.

Below, we will mainly explain the postoperative symptoms and complications as provided by the TCB official.

Possibility of left-right differences or pulling in the finish

Left-right disparity and skin tightening are symptoms that may occur after a thread lift procedure.

The TCB official explains that the left and right sides may look asymmetrical due to differences in left-right differences and swelling before the treatment, and additional treatment may be required if the threads are not pulled up enough.

Possible causes of the difference between the left and right sides include the original asymmetry of the face, swelling after the procedure, and differences in how the threads are pulled up.

Points to check regarding left and right differences/tightness
  • There may be a difference between the left and right sides even before the treatment.
  • Post-surgical swelling may cause the left and right sides to look asymmetrical.
  • Additional treatment may be required due to differences in thread pulling.

Symptoms such as tightness and denting may also occur, so if symptoms persist, please consult your doctor.

TCB officials advise that skin tightening will take about 1 week to 1 month, and dents at the thread insertion site will take about 2 weeks to 3 months.

If your symptoms are strong or worsen, please contact your treatment provider immediately.

During your consultation, be sure to confirm the original left-right differences and the thread insertion plan, and understand that there are individual differences in changes after the procedure.

Having an explanation of your doctor's background and treatment details will help you understand the risks and treatment strategy.

Downtime may be longer than expected

TCB officials advise that swelling and pain will last for about a week, and if internal bleeding occurs, it will take about one to two weeks.

The duration of symptoms varies from person to person, and may take longer than the above guideline depending on the treatment content and constitution.

Please check with your doctor for an individual outlook regarding the scope of treatment, threads used, physical condition, etc.

In case the downtime is longer than planned, know how to contact you if you need to go to the hospital or take time off.

Conditions that can affect downtime
  • Type of thread used/insertion range
  • Condition of treatment area
  • Individual differences in constitution and swelling pattern

Official downtime numbers are a general guide and not everyone will recover in the same number of days.

Before your treatment, please check with your doctor about the maximum downtime that may last, and plan your schedule to allow for time in your work and other schedules.

Possibility of not experiencing the desired effect

Thread lift is not a treatment that guarantees a permanent effect, and how the effect is felt and how long it lasts will vary depending on the treatment content and individual condition.

Depending on the degree of sagging of the skin and the amount of subcutaneous fat, the suture may not be able to pull it up as desired.

If the degree of sagging is severe, your doctor may suggest methods other than thread lift.

Conditions in which you would like to consult about thread lift
  • Severe sagging skin
  • There is a lot of subcutaneous fat, and it is difficult to achieve the desired change with just threads.
  • There is less fat in the face and the threads may be visible.

The estimated duration according to the TCB official is 6 months to 1 year for TCB Small Face Lift, 1 to 2 years for Clear Fine Lift, and 2 to 5 years for Small Face Beautiful Skin Rejuvenation.

Even if you are concerned about the final result, please consult your doctor before booking additional treatments on your own. Depending on the cause, measures other than additional surgery may be required.

During your consultation, confirm the desired changes, the limits of the treatment, the number of treatments required, and possible risks.

TCB thread lift downtime period and official guideline

The downtime of a thread lift is one of the most important points to consider when deciding whether to undergo the procedure.

Downtime symptoms/recovery patterns and countermeasures
  • Swelling and pain should last approximately 1 week, internal bleeding approximately 1 to 2 weeks.
  • Cases where pain and discomfort persist for a long time and cases where recovery occurs in a short period of time
  • Things to be careful about during downtime after thread lift treatment

The TCB official also states that swelling, pain, internal bleeding, and tightness are symptoms that vary from person to person, and do not necessarily resolve within a certain period of time.

Since the pattern of progression differs depending on swelling, internal bleeding, and pain, it is helpful to understand the guidelines for each symptom and plan your life after the procedure in order to realistically prepare.

Swelling and pain should last approximately 1 week, internal bleeding approximately 1 to 2 weeks.

The TCB official guideline for thread lifts in general is that swelling and pain will last for about a week, and if internal bleeding occurs, it will take about one to two weeks.

However, the case guide for skin rejuvenation for a small face suggests that swelling, pain, and internal bleeding should be expected to last approximately 1 to 2 weeks, which varies depending on the type of treatment.

The degree of swelling and peak time vary from person to person, so if you are concerned about the progress, please check with your treatment provider.

Internal bleeding can be noticeable, so if you have plans to go to work or go out, you need to plan your schedule well in advance.

The degree of internal bleeding varies from person to person, so be sure to check with your doctor about your symptoms before the procedure.

If you have plans to work or meet other people, we recommend that you allow some time in your schedule for the first week after treatment, as this is a time when noticeable changes are likely to occur.

The course of treatment will vary depending on the skin condition and treatment area, so please do not decide on a schedule based solely on general guidelines.

Before undergoing the procedure, be sure to check your schedule during the recovery period.

Cases where pain and discomfort persist for a long time and cases where recovery occurs in a short period of time

According to the TCB official, skin tightening after surgery is approximately 1 week to 1 month, but it may last for a long time.

Even if the pain is mild, do not push yourself too hard and follow your doctor's instructions for how to spend your time after surgery.

Difficulty opening your mouth or discomfort when moving your facial expressions may occur after a thread lift.

If the pain or tightness worsens, or if you have strong swelling or fever, please contact your treatment provider regardless of how long it has been.

Three factors that affect the length of your recovery period
  • Type, location, and number of threads inserted
  • Treatment area and skin condition
  • Are you following the precautions after the procedure?

The recovery period varies depending on the treated area, type of thread, and individual condition.

It is not possible to predict the recovery period based solely on the number of treatments.

During your pre-procedure consultation, be sure to check with your doctor about your desired number of treatments and the expected recovery period.

Things to be careful about during downtime after thread lift treatment

After the procedure, it is important to follow the precautions for daily life as explained by your doctor.

The TCB official also provides guidance on actions to avoid after the treatment, such as massage and excessive exercise.

Immediately after the treatment, avoid strong stimulation or pressure on your face.

Please refrain from sleeping on your stomach, strong face massage, and scrubbing while washing your face as these may irritate the treatment area.

Checklist of actions to avoid after treatment
  • Avoid sleeping on your stomach, strong face massages, and scrubbing.
  • Obey the restriction period advised by the treatment provider regarding drinking alcohol and strenuous exercise.
  • Ask your doctor when to reopen saunas, etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol, strenuous exercise, saunas, etc. for a period of time advised by your doctor, as these may cause swelling and internal bleeding.

Restrictions on daily life after treatment vary depending on the type of treatment. Please follow the precautions provided by TCB and check with your treatment provider if you have any questions.

Please do not touch the treatment area forcefully or undergo another beauty treatment at your own discretion, and check the reopening date in advance.

If the pain or swelling is severe, do not push yourself too hard and follow your doctor's instructions and receive the necessary examination.

Points to consider when determining the type of TCB thread lift and its suitability for treatment

At TCB, we offer thread lift menus such as TCB Small Face Lift, Clear Fine Lift, and Small Face Beautiful Skin Regeneration, depending on the purpose and area.

Features of the menu, ease of getting results, and tips for sustaining results
  • Features of TCB Small Face Lift, Small Face Beautiful Skin Regeneration, and Clear Fine Lift
  • Effects vary depending on the degree of sagging and age.
  • Duration of thread lift and precautions for daily life after treatment

The type of thread, expected changes, fees, and estimated duration of effects vary depending on the menu.

After understanding the differences between treatments, check with your doctor whether the treatment is compatible with your current sagging condition and your wishes.

Features of TCB Small Face Lift, Small Face Beautiful Skin Regeneration, and Clear Fine Lift

There are three main types of thread lifts officially announced by TCB: TCB Small Face Lift, Small Face Beautiful Skin Regeneration (Lift Up), and Clear Fine Lift.

TCB small face lift is a treatment that aims to lift the face line by inserting medical threads into the subcutaneous tissue.

For small face skin rejuvenation (lift-up), there are menus such as software that aims for a natural lift, and advanced software that aims for a stronger lift.

Clear Fine Lift is a treatment that uses thin threads to tighten and tighten the skin.

If you wish to combine multiple menus, please check with your doctor regarding indications, risks, and costs.

Please check with your doctor during your consultation before deciding which menu will suit your concerns.

Effects vary depending on the degree of sagging and age.

Suitability for thread lift is determined based on the degree of sagging, amount of subcutaneous fat, and skin condition.

Even if the sagging is relatively light, a thread lift alone may not necessarily bring about the desired change.

It is important to consult a doctor and not make a blanket judgment that certain age groups are more likely to be effective.

Points to check when determining suitability
  • [Consultation required] Even if the sagging is relatively mild, the doctor will determine whether the treatment is appropriate.
  • [Consultation required] Desired degree of lift and treatment limits
  • [Consultation required] If the sagging is strong and it is difficult to achieve the desired change with thread alone
  • [Consultation required] If there is little subcutaneous fat and the thread is easily transparent

If there is a lot of sagging, it may be difficult to achieve the desired change with just a thread lift.

Depending on the degree of sagging, other treatments such as an incisional facelift may be considered, but suitability will be determined by your doctor.

If there is little subcutaneous fat, there is a risk that the threads may be visible, so ask your doctor to check your skin condition.

In order to know in advance how likely the results will be, please be specific about the current state of your sagging skin and the desired outcome during your consultation.

Duration of thread lift and precautions for daily life after treatment

The duration of thread lift varies depending on the menu, and TCB official estimates are approximately 6 months to 1 year for TCB small face lift, 1 to 2 years for clear fine lift, and 2 to 5 years for small face and beautiful skin rejuvenation.

UV protection is useful as general skin care, but we cannot confirm that sunscreen will have a long-lasting effect on thread lift.

Sudden weight changes can affect the contours of your face and the appearance of your skin, but the duration of a thread lift cannot always be maintained.

Adjusting your sleep and daily rhythm is important for daily health management, but it is not guaranteed to prolong the effects of thread lift.

Points to be aware of in your lifestyle after surgery
  • Continue UV protection as part of your regular skin care routine.
  • Be conscious of regular health management such as avoiding sudden changes in weight
  • Adjust your sleep and life rhythm
  • Perform moisturizing care at a time and in a manner approved by your doctor.

Moisturizing is a part of daily skin care, but it cannot be concluded that it enhances the collagen production and lifting effect of threads.

After your treatment, your doctor will explain to you the restrictions on sauna use, drinking alcohol, strenuous exercise, etc., and please follow their instructions.

There is no evidence that the effects of thread lift will last long due to lifestyle alone, so the duration should be considered based on the type of treatment and individual differences.
